note: All prices, costs, hours and sales targets are planning hypotheses; no customers or results invented.

paths.name: Content studio
paths.offer: Four branded motion clips/month for trainers and local businesses.
paths.requirements: One reusable motion template. Preserve the existing OpenMontage/Fast Reel path for supplied-footage edits. Generative imagery, voice and stock are excluded.
paths.gate: Show this sample to ten warm business contacts, seek five conversations and one $297 paid two-clip pilot. Continue only if the pilot is usable and takes <=2 hours including one revision.
paths.evidence: Strong skills fit, demonstrated sample; no paid customer validation.

paths.name: Premium coaching workflow
paths.offer: The existing $497 online-coaching offer with structured check-ins and visual progress reports.
paths.requirements: Preserve existing Notion/Airtable records. No live client data is imported. LibreChat later needs a host, MongoDB/services and approved model configuration. Hours must include communication and review; no automatic program changes.
paths.gate: Have five opt-in prospect conversations. Seek one suitable enrollment at the existing price and time a fictional check-in/report dry run to <=30 minutes. Measure total support time in month one.
paths.evidence: Very strong business fit; incremental conversion/retention unmeasured.

paths.name: Inbox setup service
paths.offer: One-domain email drafting workflow, access setup and handoff training for a compatible business.
paths.requirements: Requires domain-owner access, Cloudflare Access, Email Routing/Service, R2, Durable Objects and Workers AI. Shared Access members can access all mailboxes by design. No deployment, Gmail migration or live sending verified. Provider/domain costs are separately quoted.
paths.gate: Interview three compatible domain owners; continue after one paid setup request and a non-production inbound/authentication/draft-review test.
paths.evidence: Build/typecheck passed; willingness to pay and live deployment unverified.

paths.name: Private AI workspace
paths.offer: One team workspace answering questions about approved business documents, plus training.
paths.requirements: Requires maintained host, database/services and approved provider/data policy. Camofox browser integration remains unresolved. An avatar adds ASR/TTS/model setup without proving customer value. Hardware and inference billed separately.
paths.gate: Interview three owners about one costly repeated task; continue after one paid request and ten representative synthetic-document queries pass with citations/access checks.
paths.evidence: Setup-service hypothesis; support load and hardware needs unresolved.

paths.name: Paper-research journal
paths.offer: A research journal, fee/slippage worksheet and paper-trade review template for record-keeping.
paths.repos: Vibe-Trading; AutoHedge optional; Fincept excluded commercially pending license clearance
paths.requirements: Use synthetic/public records only. Fincept has custom commercial/internal-use license terms. No profitable strategy is validated. Sell bookkeeping utility, not signals, personalized recommendations or returns. No live trading.
paths.gate: Show a synthetic example to three journal users. Continue only after one paid request, reproducible fee calculations and applicable license/marketing review.
paths.evidence: Weakest revenue evidence; no demand or trading edge validated.
